Claim 25 (Currently amended): A computer readable medium having stored thereon comprising computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the computer readable medium is a non-transitory medium. 

Claim 13 (Currently amended): A system for electronically providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard electronic coupon in the mobile device and wherein the electronic certificate selection information includes data representing certificates selected by a user. 

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a certificate authorization code.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The system of claim 14 wherein the certificate authorization code includes an electronic coupon authorization code.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a message containing a URL link to a web page displaying a barcode.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to send a control message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data, and receive, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to upload the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device as a softcard coupon and personalization data. 

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The system of claim 20 wherein the personalization data is provisioned to at least one of a secure element and mobile base band memory in the mobile device. 

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The system of claim 21 wherein the mobile device is adapted to communicate the personalization data to a wireless device reader in order to conduct a purchase transaction. 

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the mobile device comprises a first NFC enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second NFC enabled device. 

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the mobile device comprises a first NFC enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second NFC enabled device.
